para.text: Polygons in the shape of quadrangles, pentagons, hexagons etc. can be created by defining first a triangle (mode 0) and adding more and more points to it (mode 1, 2 and 3, several times if required). Beware of the correct order of the points, or the polygon becomes heavily warped.

para.text: Faces can be entered in any order. When the polyhedron is plotted the faces are sorted to their distance to the viewing position, and plotted in the order back to front.
